sources.snippet: 2 Model Architecture Architecture The architecture of Qwen2.5-Coder is derived directly from Qwen2.5. Table 1 outlines the architecture of Qwen2.5-Coder across six different model sizes: 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, and 32B parameters. While all sizes share the same architecture in terms of head size, they differ in several other key aspects.

sources.snippet: Abstract † In this report, we introduce the Qwen2.5-Coder series, a significant upgrade from its predecessor, CodeQwen1.5. This series includes two models: Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B and Qwen2.5-Coder-7B.
